about: Heard-word overlay (RULES.md S2: raw transcripts are never edited). One row per line where the engine wrote a different word than the one said; the page shows the heard word with the engine's word underneath, and every builder (ledger, marks, readers' text) reads the heard text. Hand-made: never delete a row; a changed fix is a new row later in the list. Matched by date + line start t (+-1 s) + who + engine_wrote inside the line. Applied by scripts/transcript_fixes.py.
